scope: Proposition 5.5 (A filled solution) of the manuscript “A Charged Reduction of the Spacetime Penrose Inequality in Spatial Dimensions at Least Four” (preprints/A-Charged-Reduction-of-the-Spacetime-Penrose-Inequality-in-Spatial-Dimensions-at-Least-Four-October-5-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 260 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 3e5e445d305051a1), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 38. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For fixed prepared data and ε > 0, all sufficiently large N admit a smooth solution of (4.17) on the entire one-ended filled manifold MN , with t > −ε, t ≤ Z ≤ PN , ℓ ≤ l ≤ e, |f| + |∇f| ≤ ePN . The functions f and all their derivatives decay exponentially on the end, with constants depending on fixed N. Moreover t, Z = Oj(r2−n ) for every j, ∆gt = O(r−n−β ). (5.19) The uniform height bound and the radial height estimate of Lemma 4.4 hold on the limiting solution.
